name: single_feasible_completion
rationale: Reduce six structural features to one feasible residual-completion estimate. Drop the overlapping residual-cover estimate and repeated induced-edge calculations. Removing the root's neighbors already represents their opportunity cost, so omit the separate neighbor-pack penalty. Rank by root weight plus greedy residual weight, with a small low-degree preference that scales with weight. This preserves the parent's main lookahead signal while reducing computation and dependence on auxiliary coefficients.
